picks.name: Blackdown
picks.source_note: New artist/label discovery -- Keysound Recordings co-founder. Extremely dry research day (90+ searches across labels and artists); this is a genuinely new-to-the-pool discovery, about four months old rather than brand new, disclosed per usual practice. Exact release-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link points to the artist's confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "rollage vol.9: movin' thru EP" (June 19, 2026, Keysound Recordings) is the ninth entry in Blackdown's 130bpm Rollage series -- four atmospheric, dark cuts drawing on grime, dubstep and dancehall, part of the label's ongoing 20th-anniversary run.
picks.why_listen: Foundational UK bass sound from a genuinely influential label co-founder -- dense, atmospheric 130bpm material that's a good texture shift for a darker, more rhythmically complex stretch of a set.
